## 🚀 Feature Request

**Title format:** [Feature] Brief description

### What feature would you like?
Describe what you want to add.

### Why is this useful?
Explain the benefit or problem it solves.

### Which area does this affect?
- [ ] Python Client
- [ ] Rust Server
- [ ] Networking
- [ ] Database
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other: ___

### Proposed implementation (optional)
If you have ideas on how to implement it.

### Additional context
Links, examples, related issues.
